definitions.explanation: Having characteristics of the modern era; reflecting modern standards, technology, or ways of thinking. Often implies progress and advancement.

examples.japanese: {近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
{近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}っている→整う：03935_totonou⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{共存|きょうぞん}→共存：11675_kyouzon⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In this city, old townscapes and modern buildings coexist.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes things that are modern in style, technology, or thinking, often with a positive nuance of progress. Used with な when modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (modern city)
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (modern lifestyle)
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧ (modern way of thinking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現代的|げんだいてき}→現代的：28614_gendaiteki⟧: contemporary (more focused on the present era)
- ⟦{先進的|せんしんてき}→先進的：20024_senshinteki⟧: advanced, cutting-edge
